description: This grouped bar chart, presented at a tilted angle, illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) metric across three different language models under varying fine-tuning conditions. The horizontal category axis displays the models in the following order: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, without an explicit axis label. The vertical value axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)" and features a linear scale with a visible range from 10 to 80, marked by numeric tick labels at intervals of 10. The data is organized into grouped bars, with each group containing four bars representing different training conditions as defined by an inset legend. The components of each group, arranged from left to right, are: "no SFT" represented by light blue bars with white diagonal stripes; "+ SFT on $D_0$" represented by light orange bars with white horizontal stripes; "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" represented by light purple bars with white diagonal stripes; and a fourth condition, partially visible in the legend as "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D...$", represented by solid light red bars. Across the chart, the shortest bar corresponds to the "no SFT" condition for LLaMA-2-7B at an approximate value of 68%, while the tallest bar corresponds to the solid light red condition for LLaMA-2-70B, reaching an approximate value of 98%, which extends beyond the highest visible y-axis tick mark. The groups are ordered sequentially by the model size indicated in their names, and within each group, the bars follow the top-to-bottom order of the legend. Visual emphasis is applied through the use of striped hatching patterns on the first three bars of each group, which contrasts with the solid fill of the fourth bar.
